findings.message: the source text does not describe the 'missing_info' subprocess (Missing Information); a human should confirm whether it is genuinely absent

node 'gw_test_result' (Did free test disprove on-label diagnosis?) needs human confirmation: Source describes the branch where the free test disproved the on-label diagnosis but does not state the outcome path if the test confirmed the diagnosis, nor whether the test occurs on the agreement path.

node 'term_existing_handled' (Existing patient handling determined) needs human confirmation: Source does not state what happens after CM360 determines the type of existing-patient case (re-enrollment, restart, or update).
